configurationFields.label: Weltname
configurationFields.description: Unless "Use Server Name For World Name" is enabled, sets the name of a newly generated world. The world save file will be named accordingly in the Worlds directory. If the save file already exists and is not loaded under World Save Name, then an incrementally numbered save file will be created

configurationFields.label: World Save Name
configurationFields.description: Specifies the world save file in the Worlds directory to load on start. Creates the specified file if no World Name is set or "Use Server Name For World Name" is enabled. Creates a default world save file if otherwise unspecified

configurationFields.label: Welt-Seed
configurationFields.description: Sets the world seed to use for a newly generated world. Empty = random seed

configurationFields.label: World Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the size of a newly generated world

configurationFields.label: World Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of a newly generated world

configurationFields.label: World Evil
configurationFields.description: Sets the evil state for a newly generated world

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Use Server Name For World Name
configurationFields.description: If set, the Server Name will be used as the world name of a newly generated world, with the world save file named as specified under World Save Name

configurationFields.label: MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's [MOTD](https://ikebukuro.tshock.co/#/motd) (message of the day)
configurationFields.default:
Welcome to [c/ffff00:%map%] on [c/7ddff8:T][c/81dbf6:S][c/86d7f4:h][c/8ad3f3:o][c/8ecef1:c][c/93caef:k] for [c/55d284:T][c/62d27a:e][c/6fd16f:r][c/7cd165:r][c/89d15a:a][c/95d150:r][c/a4d145:i][c/b1d03b:a].
[c/FFFFFF:Online players (%onlineplayers%/%serverslots%):] [c/FFFF00:%players%]
Type [c/55D284:%specifier%][c/62D27A:h][c/6FD16F:e][c/7CD165:l][c/89D15A:p] for a list of commands.

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Enable Anti-Spam
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the server's anti-spam feature

configurationFields.label: Server Language
configurationFields.description: Sets the language of the server

configurationFields.label: Disable Announcement Box
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the text announcements that the Announcement Box makes when pulsed from wire

configurationFields.label: Announcement Box Range
configurationFields.description: Sets the Announcement Box text messaging range. -1 = serverwide announcements

configurationFields.label: Enable Autosave
configurationFields.description: If set, the server’s backup autosave will be enabled. Backups are stored in the tshock/backups folder

configurationFields.label: Announce Autosaves
configurationFields.description: If set, world autosave announcements will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Show Autosave Messages
configurationFields.description: If set, backup autosave messages will be shown

configurationFields.label: Backup Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval between backup autosaves

configurationFields.label: Backup Retention Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long backup autosaves are kept

configurationFields.label: Save World On Crash
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the world will be saved if the server crashes from an unhandled exception

configurationFields.label: Save World On Last Player Exit
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the world will be saved when the last player disconnects

configurationFields.label: Ignore Plugin Version Checks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will ignore API version checks for plugins, allowing old plugins to run

configurationFields.label: Enable Debug Logs
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will output debug level messages related to system operation

configurationFields.label: Disable Spew Logs
configurationFields.description: If set, disables sending logs as messages to players with the log permission

configurationFields.label: Disable Second Update Logs
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents On Second Update checks from writing to the log file

configurationFields.label: Suppress Permission Failure Notices
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will suppress build permission failure warnings from regions, spawn point, or server edit failure

configurationFields.label: Disable UPnP
configurationFields.description: If set, disables UPnP (Universal Plug and Play) on the server

configurationFields.label: Server Process Priority
configurationFields.description: Sets the server process priority

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Parameters
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional command line parameters that are not otherwise set by GSCS. ONE LINE ONLY! Use with care

configurationFields.label: Force Server Running
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be forced to continue running, and not hibernate when no players are connected. This will result in time passing, grass growing, and the CPU running

configurationFields.label: Invasion Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the size of invasion events, based on: 100 + (multiplier x (number of active players with greater than 200 health))

configurationFields.label: Default Maximum Spawns
configurationFields.description: Sets the default maximum number of mobs that will spawn per wave. Higher = more mobs in that wave

configurationFields.label: Default Spawn Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the delay between waves. Lower = more mobs

configurationFields.label: Enable Infinite Invasion
configurationFields.description: If set, enables never-ending invasion events. The event still needs to be started, such as with the /invade command

configurationFields.label: PvP Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's PvP (player vs player) mode

configurationFields.label: Enable Spawn Protection
configurationFields.description: If enabled, prevents tiles from being placed within the Spawn Protection Radius of the default spawn

configurationFields.label: Spawn Protection Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the tile radius around the spawn tile that is protected by the Spawn Protection setting

configurationFields.label: Enable Range Checks
configurationFields.description: If set, enables anti-cheat range checks based on the distance between the player and their block placements

configurationFields.label: Enable Hardcore Only
configurationFields.description: If set, only hardcore players cann connect. Don't enable Softcore Only or Mediumcore Only at the same time

configurationFields.label: Enable Mediumcore Only
configurationFields.description: If set, softcore players cannot connect. Don't enable Softcore Only or Hardcore Only at the same time

configurationFields.label: Enable Softcore Only
configurationFields.description: If set, only softcore players can connect. Don't enable Mediumcore Only or Hardcore Only at the same time

configurationFields.label: Disable Building
configurationFields.description: If set, disables any placing or removal of blocks

configurationFields.label: Disable Hardmode
configurationFields.description: If set, hardmode will not be activated by the Wall of Flesh or the /starthardmode command

configurationFields.label: Disable Dungeon Guardian
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents the dungeon guardian from being spawned, while sending players to their spawn point instead

configurationFields.label: Disable Clown Bombs
configurationFields.description: If set, disables clown bomb projectiles from spawning

configurationFields.label: Disable Snowballs
configurationFields.description: If set, disables snowball projectiles from spawning

configurationFields.label: Disable Tombstones
configurationFields.description: If set, disables tombstone dropping during death for all players

configurationFields.label: Disable Prime Bombs
configurationFields.description: If set, disables Skeletron Prime Bombs from spawning. Useful for preventing unwanted world destruction on "for the worthy" seed worlds

configurationFields.label: Force Time
configurationFields.description: Forces the world time to the specified setting

configurationFields.label: Disable PvP Invisibility
configurationFields.description: If set, disables the effect of invisibility potions while PvP is enabled, by making the player visible to the other players

configurationFields.label: Maximum Range For Disabled Players
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum distance that disabled players can move from

configurationFields.label: Enable Region Protection For Chests
configurationFields.description: If enabled, region protection will apply to chests

configurationFields.label: Enable Region Protection For Gem Locks
configurationFields.description: If enabled, region protection will apply to gem locks

configurationFields.label: Maximum Player/NPC Damage
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum damage a player/NPC can inflict

configurationFields.label: Maximum Projectile Damage
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum damage a projectile can inflict

configurationFields.label: Ignore Projectile Update
configurationFields.description: If set, ignores checks to see if a player can update a projectile

configurationFields.label: Ignore Projectile Kill
configurationFields.description: If set, ignores checks to see if a player can kill a projectile

configurationFields.label: Allow Cut Tiles And Breakables
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to break temporary tiles (grass, pots, etc) where they cannot usually build

configurationFields.label: Allow Ice
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows ice placement even where a player cannot usually build

configurationFields.label: Allow Hardmode Crimson Creep
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the crimson to spread when a world is in hardmode

configurationFields.label: Allow Hardmode Corruption Creep
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the corruption to spread when a world is in hardmode

configurationFields.label: Allow Hardmode Hallow Creep
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows the hallow to spread when a world is in hardmode

configurationFields.label: Statue Spawn Within 200 Pixels
configurationFields.description: Sets how many NPCs a statue can spawn within 200 pixels before it stops spawning

configurationFields.label: Statue Spawn Within 600 Pixels
configurationFields.description: Sets how many NPCs a statue can spawn within 600 pixels before it stops spawning

configurationFields.label: Statue Spawn Within World
configurationFields.description: Sets how many NPCs a statue can spawn before it stops spawning

configurationFields.label: Prevent Banned Item Spawn
configurationFields.description: If enabled, prevents banned items from being spawned or given with commands

configurationFields.label: Prevent Dead Modification
configurationFields.description: If enabled, prevents players from interacting with the world while they are dead

configurationFields.label: Prevent Invalid Place Style
configurationFields.description: If enabled, prevents players from placing tiles with an invalid style

configurationFields.label: Force Christmas
configurationFields.description: If enabled, forces Christmas-only events to occur all year

configurationFields.label: Force Halloween
configurationFields.description: If enabled, forces Halloween-only events to occur all year

configurationFields.label: Allow Allowed Groups To Spawn Banned Items
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows groups on the banned item allowed list to spawn banned items even if Prevent Banned Item Spawn is enabled

configurationFields.label: Ignore Chest Stacks On Load
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows stacks in chests to go beyond the stack limit during world loading

configurationFields.label: Anonymous Boss Invasions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, boss spawning and invasion starts will be announced

configurationFields.label: Bomb Explosion Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the range over which a bomb can affect tiles from its detonation point

configurationFields.label: Give Items Directly
configurationFields.description: If enabled, items given to players will be inserted directly into their inventory. Requires SSC. Otherwise, items given to players will spawn as dropped items. Experimental - may not work correctly or may result in item loss

configurationFields.label: Disable Modified Zenith
configurationFields.description: If set, prohibits the use of the Zenith projectile with different objects instead of weapons

configurationFields.label: Disable Custom Death Messages
configurationFields.description: If set, enables protection against creating custom messages with death

configurationFields.label: Command Specifier
configurationFields.description: Specifies which string starts a command. Note: Will not function properly if the string length is bigger than 1

configurationFields.label: Command Silent Specifier
configurationFields.description: Specifies which string starts a command silently. Note: Will not function properly if the string length is bigger than 1

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum numbers of players that can connect at one time

configurationFields.label: Reserved Player Slots
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of reserved slots above the Player Limit that can be joined by reserved players

configurationFields.label: Enable Whitelist
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the server's whitelist based on IP addresses in tshock/whitelist.txt

configurationFields.label: Whitelist Kick Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when kicking players for not being on the whitelist
configurationFields.default: You are not on the whitelist.

configurationFields.label: Server Full With No Reserved Slots Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when kicking players that attempt to join while the server is full with no reserved slots available
configurationFields.default: Server is full. No reserved slots open.

configurationFields.label: Server Full Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when kicking players that attempt to join while the server is full

configurationFields.label: Default Registration Group Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the default group name to place newly registered users under

configurationFields.label: Default Guest Group Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the default group name to place unregistered players under

configurationFields.label: Remember Leave Position
configurationFields.description: If enabled, remembers where a player left off, based on their IP. Does not persist through server restarts

configurationFields.label: Require Login Or Registration
configurationFields.description: If enabled, requires all players to register or login before being allowed to play

configurationFields.label: Allow Login With Any Username
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to login to any account even if the username doesn't match their character name

configurationFields.label: Allow Registration With Any Username
configurationFields.description: If enabled, allows players to register a username that doesn't necessarily match their character name

configurationFields.label: Maximum Login Attempts
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of failed login attempts before kicking a player

configurationFields.label: Disable Login Before Join
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents players from being able to login before they finish connecting

configurationFields.label: Display IP To Admins
configurationFields.description: If enabled, displays a player's IP on join to users with the log permission

configurationFields.label: Announce Player Geographic Location
configurationFields.description: If enabled, a player's geographic location will be announced on join, based on their IP

configurationFields.label: Kick Proxy Users
configurationFields.description: If set, and Announce Player Geographic Location is enabled, users identified as being under a proxy will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Disable Default IP Bans
configurationFields.description: If set, disables IP bans by default, if no arguments are passed to the ban command

configurationFields.label: Minimum Password Length
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum password length for new user accounts

configurationFields.label: BCrypt Work Factor
configurationFields.description: Determines the BCrypt work factor to use. If increased, all passwords will be upgraded to the new work-factor on verify. The number of computational rounds is 2^n. Increase with caution

configurationFields.label: Disable UUID Login
configurationFields.description: If set, prevents players from being able to login with their client UUID

configurationFields.label: Kick Empty UUID
configurationFields.description: If enabled, clients that don't send their UUID to the server will be kicked

configurationFields.label: Kick On Mediumcore Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, mediumcore players will be kicked on death

configurationFields.label: Mediumcore Kick Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when kicking a mediumcore player on death

configurationFields.label: Ban On Mediumcore Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, mediumcore players will be banned on death

configurationFields.label: Mediumcore Ban Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when banning a mediumcore player on death

configurationFields.label: Kick On Hardcore Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, hardcore players will be kicked on death

configurationFields.label: Hardcore Kick Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when kicking a hardcore player on death

configurationFields.label: Ban On Hardcore Death
configurationFields.description: If enabled, hardcore players will be banned on death

configurationFields.label: Hardcore Ban Reason
configurationFields.description: Sets the reason given when banning a hardcore player on death

configurationFields.label: Respawn Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the period a player must wait before being respawned. Use at your own risk

configurationFields.label: Respawn Boss Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the period a player must wait before being respawned if there is a boss nearby. Use at your own risk

configurationFields.label: Maximum HP
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum HP a player can have, before equipment buffs

configurationFields.label: Maximum MP
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum MP a player can have, before equipment buffs

configurationFields.label: Tile Paint Threshold
configurationFields.description: Disables a player if the set number of tiles is painted within 1 second

configurationFields.label: Kick On Tile Paint Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Tile Paint Threshold

configurationFields.label: Tile Kill Threshold
configurationFields.description: Disables a player and reverts their actions if the set number of tile kills is exceeded within 1 second

configurationFields.label: Kick On Tile Kill Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Tile Kill Threshold

configurationFields.label: Tile Place Threshold
configurationFields.description: Disables a player and reverts their actions if the set number of tile places is exceeded within 1 second

configurationFields.label: Kick On Tile Place Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Tile Place Threshold

configurationFields.label: Tile Liquid Threshold
configurationFields.description: Disables a player if the set number of liquid sets is exceeded within 1 second

configurationFields.label: Kick On Tile Liquid Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Tile Liquid Threshold

configurationFields.label: Kick On Damage Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Maximum Player/NPC Damage

configurationFields.label: Ignore Shrapnel For Projectile Threshold
configurationFields.description: If set, shrapnel from crystal bullets will be ignored for the projectile threshold count

configurationFields.label: Projectile Threshold
configurationFields.description: Disables a player if the set number of projectiles is created within 1 second

configurationFields.label: Kick On Projectile Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Projectile Threshold

configurationFields.label: Heal Other Threshold
configurationFields.description: Disables a player if the set number of Heal Other Player packets is sent within 1 second

configurationFields.label: Kick On Heal Other Threshold Broken
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be kicked when they surpass the Heal Other Threshold

configurationFields.label: Chat Format
configurationFields.description: Changes in-game chat format: {0} = Group Name, {1} = Group Prefix, {2} = Player Name, {3} = Group Suffix, {4} = Chat Message

configurationFields.label: Enable Chat Above Heads
configurationFields.description: If enabled, chat messages will be displayed above players' heads

configurationFields.label: Chat Above Heads Format
configurationFields.description: Changes the player name when using Chat Above Heads. Starts with a player name wrapped in brackets, as per Terraria's formatting. Same formatting as Chat Format without the message

configurationFields.label: Superadmin Chat Prefix
configurationFields.description: Sets the superadmin chat prefix

configurationFields.label: Superadmin Chat Suffix
configurationFields.description: Sets the superadmin chat suffix

configurationFields.label: Enable Rest API
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the REST API

configurationFields.label: Log REST API Connections
configurationFields.description: If enabled, REST API connections will be logged

configurationFields.label: Enable REST API Token Authentication
configurationFields.description: If enabled, token authentication will be required to use the public REST API endpoints

configurationFields.label: Maximum REST API Requests Per Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum REST API requests in the bucket before denying requests

configurationFields.label: REST API Request Bucket Decrease Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets how often the REST API requests bucket is decreased by one

configurationFields.label: Database Storage Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the type of database to use when storing data

configurationFields.label: SQLite Database Path
configurationFields.description: Sets the path of the SQLite database, when using the SQLite database type

configurationFields.label: MySQL Hostname And Port
configurationFields.description: Sets the MySQL hostname and port to direct connections to, when using the MySQL database type

configurationFields.label: MySQL Database Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the database name to connect to when using the MySQL database type

configurationFields.label: MySQL Username
configurationFields.description: Sets the username to use when connecting to a MySQL database

configurationFields.label: MySQL Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to use when connecting to a MySQL database

configurationFields.label: Use SQL Log
configurationFields.description: If enabled, logs will be saved to the SQL database instead of a text file

configurationFields.label: Failures Before Text Log Reversion
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of times the SQL log must fail to insert logs before falling back to the text log

configurationFields.label: Dotnet Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [ASP.NET Core Runtime 9.0 version](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/9.0) to install for TShock. Empty = latest. NOTE: Update the server after switching versions!

deploymentSteps.name: ASP.NET Core Runtime Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{DOTNETVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path '{SERVER_DIR}/'; if (Test-Path 'dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion = (& dotnet/dotnet.exe --list-runtimes | Where-Object { $_ -like 'Microsoft.AspNetCore.App*' } | Select-Object -First 1).Split()[1] } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/9.0/releases.json).\"latest-runtime\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid ASP.NET Core Runtime version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/Runtime/$DotnetVersion/aspnetcore-runtime-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \"ASP.NET Core Runtime v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"
